2200.name: The Dark Woods

north.description: To the north lies The Black Forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Woods.

2200.description:
The Dark Woods crowd the track so closely that daylight comes down grey
and thin, and the trunks stand black with damp. Roots break through the
leaf-mould like knuckles, and a rank tang of old woodsmoke hangs between
the boughs. The track runs north toward the Black Forest and south
through more of the woods. Someone has hacked a rough notch into every
tenth tree, high up where only a giant could reach.

2201.name: The Dark Woods

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Woods.

south.description: To the south lies The Small Intersection In The Forest.

2201.description:
The path through the Dark Woods narrows to a deer-track between rank
bushes, with branches meeting overhead. Rusted iron spikes have been
hammered into several trunks and hung with strings of knucklebones.
Black woods lead north, and the track opens south at a small crossing.
The air smells of resin and wet earth.

2202.name: The Small Intersection In The Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Woods.

east.description: To the east lies In The Dense Forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Edge Of The Forest And Hills.

2202.description:
Three tracks meet in a small clearing in the forest, and a split stump
marks the crossing. A trail runs north into the Dark Woods, another east
into denser forest, and a third south to where the trees give way to
hills. Pale lichen grows on the stump, and a few crow feathers lie
pinned beneath a stone.

2203.name: The Edge Of The Forest And Hills

north.description: To the north lies The Small Intersection In The Forest.

west.description: To the west lies The Rocky Path.

2203.description:
The forest thins into rough hills here: the last pines give way to
heather and bare knuckles of rock. A trodden way leads north to a small
intersection under the trees, and a stony path climbs west. A cairn of
three flat stones, topped by a cracked skull, stands beside the track.

2204.name: In The Dense Forest

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Forest Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Small Intersection In The Forest.

2204.description:
Dense forest presses in from every side, the trunks knotted with creeper
and the undergrowth chest-high and wet. A narrow lane has been broken
through it by something broad and heavy, leaving snapped saplings along
both edges. The lane bends south toward a darker path and west back to a
small intersection. Dripping leaves patter softly on your shoulders.

2205.name: The Dark Forest Path

north.description: To the north lies In The Dense Forest.

east.description: To the east lies The Swampy Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Turn In The Path.

2205.description:
The Dark Forest Path is a hollow of trodden mud between black trunks,
rutted deep by great bare feet. Strings of hair-braided charms swing
from the lowest branches and clack together in the draught. A boggier
way wanders east, a bend of the path lies south, and the dense forest
rises to the north. The air tastes of peat and smoke.

2206.name: A Turn In The Path

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Forest Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Bloody Intersection.

2206.description:
The path turns sharply here, bending around a boulder as tall as a hut
and daubed with a red handprint. Old campfire ash and gnawed bones
scatter the ground at its foot. The track leads north toward the dark
forest path and west toward a place where the ground is stained dark.
Crows have scratched the earth bare along the verge.

2207.name: The Bloody Intersection

east.description: To the east lies A Turn In The Path.

south.description: To the south lies Up the Rocky Hillside.

west.description: To the west lies The Rocky Path.

2207.description:
This is the Bloody Intersection, and it has earned the name. The packed
earth is stained brown-red in broad splashes, the flat rocks are crusted
black, and bones of every size are heaped against the stones, some still
hung with rags of flesh. A path leads east toward a turning, another
runs west along a rocky track, and a steep hillside rises south. The
ogres feast here, and their leavings stink in the heat.

extra_descs.stains blood stones intersection:
The stones have been stained so many times they no longer dry. Hundreds
of knucklebones have been pressed into the clay between them.

2208.name: The Rocky Path

north.description: To the north lies The Rocky Path.

east.description: To the east lies The Bloody Intersection.

2208.description:
A rocky path winds over broken stone, climbing and dropping among
tumbled boulders. The rock here is grey and sharp, and little grows but
lichens. The path leads north along a ridge and east toward a stained
crossing. Fresh bones have been scattered along the verge, picked clean.

2209.name: The Rocky Path

east.description: To the east lies The Edge Of The Forest And Hills.

south.description: To the south lies The Rocky Path.

2209.description:
The rocky path squeezes between two grey outcrops before it drops toward
the trees. Chips of flint litter the track, and the stone is scored with
long parallel gouges where something has dragged heavy timber. The path
runs east to the edge of the forest and south among tumbled boulders.

2210.name: Up the Rocky Hillside

north.description: To the north lies The Bloody Intersection.

east.description: To the east lies Standing On Level Ground.

south.description: To the south lies Before The Huge Tree.

west.description: To the west lies The Sparse Foothills.

2210.description:
A steep rocky hillside rises here, strewn with loose scree that rattles
away underfoot. Scrubby gorse clings in the crevices between boulders.
The slope flattens to the north at a bloody crossing, runs on east to
level ground, south toward a huge tree, and west across sparse
foothills. Cold wind whips the grey stones.

2211.name: The Sparse Foothills

east.description: To the east lies Up the Rocky Hillside.

south.description: To the south lies In The Foothills.

2211.description:
The foothills are sparse and stony here, with a thin skin of heather
over the rock. A broken stone wall, long fallen, can be traced across
the slope by its line of mossy rubble. The ground climbs east toward a
rocky hillside and rolls south through low hills. Nothing taller than a
thistle grows within sight.

2212.name: Standing On Level Ground

south.description: To the south lies Before the Dark Cave.

west.description: To the west lies Up the Rocky Hillside.

2212.description:
You stand on a shelf of level ground cut into the hillside, short-
grassed and windy. Flat stones are ringed around a blackened fire pit
that has been used many times. The steep hillside lies west, and a dark
cave mouth yawns to the south. Smoke stains streak the rock above it.

2213.name: In The Foothills

north.description: To the north lies The Sparse Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies Before The Huge Tree.

south.description: To the south lies The Hills Overlooking The Shore.

2213.description:
These foothills are rolling and bare, grassed with wiry tussocks and
dotted with pale outcrops. A shallow gully, scoured by old rains, runs
away downhill. The hills rise gently north, east toward a huge tree, and
south toward a view of the sea. The wind is steady and carries the tang
of salt.

2214.name: Before The Huge Tree

north.description: To the north lies Up the Rocky Hillside.

east.description: To the east lies Before the Dark Cave.

south.description: To the south lies The Hills Overlooking The Shoreline.

west.description: To the west lies In The Foothills.

2214.description:
A huge tree stands alone on the hilltop, its trunk gnarled and fissured,
its roots clutching the stony slope. Strips of hide have been nailed
into the bark, stiff and dark, and old arrowheads of flint litter the
earth at its foot. The hill continues north up the slope, east to a dark
cave, south along the ridge, and west through low foothills.

2215.name: Before the Dark Cave

north.description: To the north lies Standing On Level Ground.

east.description: To the east lies Inside The Horrid Cave.

south.description: To the south lies The Hills Above The Shoreline.

west.description: To the west lies Before The Huge Tree.

2215.description:
A broad, ragged mouth of black rock opens in the hillside here, ringed
with piled skulls and cairns of broken stone. The smell of old meat and
wet fur breathes out of the darkness. The cave itself lies east, while
level ground is to the north, hills fall away south toward a distant
shoreline, and a huge tree stands west. Deep gouges in the floor lead
into the gloom.

2216.name: Inside The Horrid Cave

west.description: To the west lies Before the Dark Cave.

2216.description:
Inside the horrid cave the air is warm, close and foul. Rough walls
sweat with moisture, and heaps of gnawed bones and filthy hides are
piled in the corners. Little light reaches this far from the entrance,
and the floor is slick with grease. The only way out is back west into
the daylight.

2217.name: The Hills Overlooking The Shore

north.description: To the north lies In The Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies The Hills Overlooking The Shoreline.

down.description: To the down lies The Rocky Shore.

2217.description:
The hills overlooking the shore end in a ragged edge, beyond which
spreads a wide sweep of cold grey sea. Salt-burned heather scrubs the
ground, and the wind pulls at your clothes. The hills continue north and
east, and a steep scramble leads down to the rocky shore. Broken shells
have been dropped across the turf by the sea birds.

2218.name: The Hills Overlooking The Shoreline

north.description: To the north lies Before The Huge Tree.

east.description: To the east lies The Hills Above The Shoreline.

west.description: To the west lies The Hills Overlooking The Shore.

down.description: To the down lies The Rocky Shoreline.

2218.description:
From the hills overlooking the shoreline you can see surf breaking on
black rocks far below. The turf is thin and wiry, studded with sea-pink
and thrift. Slopes continue north toward a huge tree, east and west
along the hill, and a steep path drops down to the rocky shoreline. A
single wind-bent thorn stands over the edge.

2219.name: The Hills Above The Shoreline

north.description: To the north lies Before the Dark Cave.

west.description: To the west lies The Hills Overlooking The Shoreline.

down.description: To the down lies The Rocky Shore.

2219.description:
Wind sings across the hills above the shoreline, flattening the coarse
grass in long ripples. The sea shows grey and endless far below, and
gulls wheel as tiny white flecks. A cave mouth gapes north, the hills
roll west, and a goat-track drops down a broken slope to the rocky
shore. A leaning pile of stones marks the path's head.

2220.name: The Rocky Shore

east.description: To the east lies The Rocky Shoreline.

south.description: To the south lies The Edge Of The Sea.

up.description: To the up lies The Hills Overlooking The Shore.

2220.description:
Wet black rocks, slimed with weed, litter the shore here, and the surf
pounds them in slow booms. Tide pools hold small drifts of foam and
crushed shells. The shore runs on east along the rocks, a waterline path
leads south to the edge of the sea, and a steep slope climbs up to the
hills. Everything is salt, spray and cold.

2221.name: The Rocky Shoreline

east.description: To the east lies The Rocky Shore.

south.description: To the south lies The Edge Of The Sea.

west.description: To the west lies The Rocky Shore.

up.description: To the up lies The Hills Overlooking The Shoreline.

2221.description:
The rocky shoreline is a jumble of boulders and shingle, polished by
centuries of storm. A line of tangled kelp and driftwood marks the high
tide. Shore stretches east and west along the foot of the cliffs, the
edge of the sea lies south, and a steep path climbs to the hills above.
Gulls scream overhead.

2222.name: The Rocky Shore

north.description: To the north lies A Damp Alcove.

south.description: To the south lies The Edge Of The Sea.

west.description: To the west lies The Rocky Shoreline.

up.description: To the up lies The Hills Above The Shoreline.

2222.description:
Long grey waves run in against the rocky shore, hissing through the
shingle. In the cliff face a dark gap opens to the north, damp and
strangely quiet, from which a faint chill seeps. The shore continues
west along the rocks, the edge of the sea lies south, and a steep path
climbs back up to the hills. A wrecked oar lies jammed between the
stones.

2223.name: The Edge Of The Sea

north.description: To the north lies The Rocky Shore.

east.description: To the east lies The Edge Of The Sea.

2223.description:
A narrow beach of grey shingle lies at the edge of the sea, strewn with
bleached bones of fish and seabirds. The waves slide in slow and heavy,
trailing long ribbons of weed. Rocks rise north toward the shore, and
the sea's edge runs east. A rusted iron ring has been driven into a
boulder.

2224.name: The Edge Of The Sea

north.description: To the north lies The Rocky Shoreline.

east.description: To the east lies The Edge Of The Sea.

south.description: To the south lies Floating In Blue Light.

west.description: To the west lies The Edge Of The Sea.

2224.description:
The land ends in a ledge of jagged rock where the sea heaves and sucks
below. Beyond it, a strange blue light shines on the water, cold and
unsteady. The shore lies north, the edge of the sea runs east and west,
and the way south leads out onto the glow. Ice crusts the lowest stones.

2225.name: The Edge Of The Sea

north.description: To the north lies The Rocky Shore.

west.description: To the west lies The Edge Of The Sea.

2225.description:
Here the land gives out into the sea, and the grey water laps at the
last broken stones. Barnacles crust every rock, and the wind carries a
thin, bitter spray. The shore lies north, and the edge of the sea
continues west along the stones. Far across the water the horizon is a
blur of cloud.

2226.name: Floating In Blue Light

north.description: To the north lies The Edge Of The Sea.

south.description: To the south lies The Glacier Temple.

2226.description:
You drift on dark water in a strange cold light, blue as the heart of a
glacier. Slabs of pale ice turn slowly around you, and the swell lifts
and drops you without a sound. Shore lies back north, and a great shape
of ice rises ahead, south. The air is bitter enough to ache in your
lungs.

2227.name: The Swampy Path

east.description: To the east lies The Swampy Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Dark Forest Path.

2227.description:
The path sinks into black mud here, and each step comes up with a slow
sucking sound. Rotten planks have been laid across the worst of the
ooze, and a green film of scum covers the pools on either side. The
swamp stretches east along the path, and firmer ground lies west toward
the forest. Midges swarm thick over the stagnant water.

2228.name: The Swampy Path

east.description: To the east lies The Swampy Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Swampy Path.

2228.description:
Tussocks of yellow sedge rise out of the swamp on both sides of the
path, with brown water glinting between them. Half-sunken logs make a
crooked causeway of sorts, slick with algae. The path runs east and
west, and in either direction the way is no cleaner. A low pale mist
hangs low over the pools.

2229.name: The Swampy Path

east.description: To the east lies The Turn in the Swampy Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Swampy Path.

2229.description:
Dead trees lean out of the stagnant swamp like gallows, bare of bark and
hung with trailing moss. The path is little more than a ridge of peat,
soft and dangerous to the side. It continues east to a sharp turn and
west the way you came. Bubbles of foul gas rise and burst in the black
water.

2230.name: The Turn in the Swampy Path

south.description: To the south lies The Swampy Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Swampy Path.

2230.description:
The path bends hard here, skirting a deep, brown pool fringed with
rotting reeds. Great ragged claw-prints cross the mud where something
came up out of the water to cool itself. One arm of the path leads south
into the mist, and the other runs west along the ridge of peat. The
stink of bog and rot is close to overpowering.

2231.name: The Swampy Path

north.description: To the north lies The Turn in the Swampy Path.

south.description: To the south lies Lost in the Mist.

2231.description:
A fog thickens as the path crosses a wide flat of black marsh. Skeletal
reeds rattle in the damp wind, and a few withered gibbets of twisted
wire hold only scraps of cloth. To the north the path returns toward a
sharp bend; ahead south, the mist swallows the track entirely.
Everything is wet and grey.

2232.name: Lost in the Mist
2232.description:
Mist lies on the hummocks like wet wool, and the grass underfoot is
silver with beaded damp. Every direction looks exactly like every other,
and the only landmark is a lopsided mound that seems to drift from view
as you approach. Somewhere a stream chuckles, always at the edge of
hearing, never any nearer.

2233.name: Lost in the Mist

north.description: To the north lies The Swampy Path.

south.description: To the south lies Lost in the Mist.

2233.description:
The mist is so thick here that you can barely see your own hands, and
the world shrinks to a few yards of dripping peat. Shapes that might be
trees or standing figures loom up and fade. Only one way is certain:
back along the path to the north. The silence is broken now and then by
a distant, heavy splash.

2234.name: Lost in the Mist
2234.description:
A low ridge of black stone breaks the hillside here, its top furred with
moss and lost in the fog. The mist is colder in the hollow beneath it
and smells of iron and turned earth. Your own footsteps return from the
grey as a muffled thump, as if another walker followed just out of
sight.

2235.name: Lost in the Mist
2235.description:
The hill dips into a bowl of heather, soaked and drooping under a
ceiling of white mist. A few standing stones lean at odd angles, their
lichen glowing faintly yellow in the murk. Moisture beads on your
clothes and runs in thin lines down your face. You turn about and find
you cannot tell where you entered.

2236.name: Lost in the Mist

north.description: To the north lies Lost in the Mist.

2236.description:
Tufts of rank grass and clumps of thistle dot a slope that rises and
falls without reason. The mist is pierced here by a few thin spars of
dead timber, bleached and splintered. Droplets fall from them in a
steady tick, like a counting clock. Every direction gives the same view
of grey.

2237.name: Lost in the Mist
2237.description:
A shallow ford of black water winds through these misty hills, only
inches deep and clouded with silt. Wet stepping-stones show for a moment
and then dissolve into the whiteness. The fog is thick enough to taste,
flat and mineral on the tongue. A dull drumbeat sounds from somewhere
beyond the haze, or perhaps it is only your pulse.

2238.name: Lost in the Mist

east.description: To the east lies The Solid Path.

2238.description:
The mist thins to a ragged curtain among the last trees, and the trunks
stand like dark bars against the pale air. A firmer track begins here,
its surface beaten flat by many large feet, leading east out of the
murk. Dead leaves hang motionless in the damp. The lost way behind you
is a wall of wet grey.

2239.name: The Solid Path

north.description: To the north lies A Forested Path.

west.description: To the west lies Lost in the Mist.

2239.description:
Solid ground at last: a causeway of packed stone and gravel runs over
the hills, its edges laid out with big rough rocks. Wheel ruts and the
deep prints of bare feet mark the surface. The path leads north into a
forested track, and west back into the mist. A faint smell of cookfires
sits on the breeze.

2240.name: A Forested Path

north.description: To the north lies The Gate Before the Ogre Village.

south.description: To the south lies The Solid Path.

2240.description:
A forested path winds between old firs, its surface trampled to a pale
ribbon by heavy traffic. Bones and broken pots lie in the ditch, and
strips of hide dangle from the low branches as warnings. The track runs
north toward a distant palisade and south to a solid causeway. Thin
smoke drifts through the treetops.

2241.name: The Gate Before the Ogre Village

north.description: To the north lies Inside the Gates.

south.description: To the south lies A Forested Path.

2241.description:
A palisade of sharpened logs, each as thick as a barrel, bars the forest
here, its points hung with skulls of every shape and size. A broad gate
of lashed timber stands open to the north, flanked by two watchtowers of
crude planks. Beyond it, the ogre village crowds around its cookfires.
The track runs back south into the forest.

extra_descs.palisade gate skulls towers:
The skulls on the palisade range from wolf to bear to man, most of them
cracked open. The gate hinges are bound with hide and thick as a man's
waist.

2242.name: Among the Crude Huts

north.description: To the north lies The Gathering Place.

east.description: To the east lies Inside the Gates.

2242.description:
Crude huts squat shoulder to shoulder around this corner of the village,
their roofs patched with hides and turf. A rusty cauldron the size of a
cartwheel sits cold upon a tripod of lashed logs. A lane leads north to
the gathering place, and another runs east toward the village gates.
Bones, ashes and broken tools litter the mud.

2243.name: Inside the Gates

north.description: To the north lies The Firepit Before the Lodge.

east.description: To the east lies Among the Crude Huts.

south.description: To the south lies The Gate Before the Ogre Village.

west.description: To the west lies Among the Crude Huts.

2243.description:
You are just inside the gates of the ogre village, standing on churned
and filthy ground. Crude huts of timber, mud and hide squat on either
hand, and the great gate stands open to the south. A wide trodden way
leads north toward a smoking firepit, with lanes running east and west
among the huts. The stench of woodsmoke, meat and midden is
overwhelming.

2244.name: Among the Crude Huts

north.description: To the north lies The Village Dump.

west.description: To the west lies Inside the Gates.

2244.description:
Low huts of mud, timber and hide are crammed together here, their doors
hung with stinking skins. Drying racks stand outside, strung with strips
of grey meat and braided gut. A lane leads north to a heap of refuse,
and another wanders west toward the village gates. The ground is trodden
to filthy slurry.

2245.name: The Gathering Place

east.description: To the east lies The Firepit Before the Lodge.

south.description: To the south lies Among the Crude Huts.

2245.description:
This is the gathering place of the ogres: a wide trampled square rimmed
by log benches and smoke-blackened stumps. A tall pole planted in the
centre bears a ring of sun-whitened skulls. The firepit and lodge are
close to the east, and a lane leads south among the huts. Old
bloodstains darken the packed earth.

2246.name: The Firepit Before the Lodge

north.description: To the north lies The Entryway to the Lodge.

east.description: To the east lies The Village Dump.

south.description: To the south lies Inside the Gates.

west.description: To the west lies The Gathering Place.

2246.description:
A huge firepit smoulders in the middle of the clearing, ringed by
blackened boulders and heaped with charred bones. Spits of green wood
stand over the embers, still dripping fat. The great lodge of the ogre
chieftain looms to the north, the village dump lies east, a gathering
place west, and the gates lie back south.

extra_descs.firepit fire pit boulders:
The pit has burned for so long that its boulders have cracked in the
heat. Bones of every kind jut from the ashes, and the char is a hand
deep.

2247.name: The Village Dump

south.description: To the south lies Among the Crude Huts.

west.description: To the west lies The Firepit Before the Lodge.

2247.description:
The village dump is a stinking hollow heaped with gnawed bones, rotten
hides and smashed pottery. Flies blacken every surface, and ragged
scraps of cloth flutter from the refuse. The ground is soft and sour
underfoot. A rutted path leads south among the huts, and another goes
west to the firepit.

2248.name: The Entryway to the Lodge

north.description: To the north lies The Throne Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Firepit Before the Lodge.

2248.description:
The entryway to the lodge is a long hall of massive uprights, hung with
trophy skulls and the pelts of great beasts. Smoke curls through the
rafters from a fire pit set in the floor, its glow flickering across
mud-daubed walls. The way south leads out to the firepit, and wide doors
lead north into the throne room. The floor is packed hard and greasy
with spilled fat.

2249.name: The Throne Room

north.description: To the north lies The Chieftain's Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Entryway to the Lodge.

2249.description:
The throne room is a vast timber hall black with smoke, its roof beams
sagging under trophies of war. At its head stands a throne of piled
bones and rough timber, draped with a bearskin. Torches gutter in iron
cressets along the walls. A narrow doorway leads north to the
chieftain's own room, and the hall opens back south to the entryway.

extra_descs.throne bones bearskin:
The throne is made of leg bones and jawbones lashed together with sinew.
The bearskin that covers the seat is big enough to wrap three men.

2250.name: The Chieftain's Room

south.description: To the south lies The Throne Room.

2250.description:
The chieftain's room is a low, hot chamber, thick with the smell of musk
and old grease. A bed of heaped furs and straw takes up one end, and
war-trophies of every kind cover the walls, from broken shields to
rusted helms. A single narrow window lets in a bar of pale smoke-stained
light. The only way out is south, back into the throne room.

2251.name: The Frigid Wastelands

north.description: To the north lies The Glacier Temple.

east.description: To the east lies The Frigid Wastelands.

2251.description:
A flat white waste of snow and ice stretches in every direction, scoured
by a bitter wind. The cold bites through cloth and leather. No trail,
post or landmark breaks the whiteness, and your own footprints fill with
drifting snow almost as soon as they are made.

2252.name: The Frigid Wastelands

west.description: To the west lies The Frigid Wastelands.

east.description: To the east lies The Frigid Wastelands.

2252.description:
A flat plain of old snow stretches away under a pale, low sun. The wind
combs long ridges across it, and every ridge looks the same. The cold is
so intense that your breath turns to needles of rime in the air.

2253.name: The Glacier Temple

north.description: To the north lies Floating In Blue Light.

south.description: To the south lies The Frigid Wastelands.

2253.description:
A temple of ice rises out of the frozen sea, its walls and pillars cut
from glacier as clear as glass. Blue light pours through the vaulted
roof and glitters on carved ogre faces frozen in the walls. A broken
altar of black stone stands in the middle, rimed with frost. Water lies
back north, and the door south opens on bare snow and wind.

extra_descs.altar black stone:
The altar is a single slab of black stone, split down the middle. Dark
old stains have soaked into its top beneath the frost.

2254.name: The Frigid Wastelands

west.description: To the west lies The Frigid Wastelands.

2254.description:
Wind has carved the drifts here into fluted, frozen waves with knife-
edged crests. A scatter of black rock breaks through the snow, glazed
with ice. Nothing moves, and the only sound is the dry hiss of blown
crystals. The cold gnaws your fingers and the tip of your nose.

2255.name: The Frigid Wastelands
2255.description:
A long frozen stream lies beneath a skin of wind-polished ice, so clear
that you can see stones and trapped leaves deep inside. Banks of old
snow rise on both sides. Cracks run through the ice with sudden groaning
reports. The sky overhead is a dull steel colour, promising more snow.

2256.name: The Frigid Wastelands
2256.description:
The snow is churned here by huge, deep tracks which end in frozen
puddles, and bones of some great animal jut from the drift, coated in
frost. A few shreds of fur flutter from a ragged post of driftwood. The
cold is relentless and the horizon is lost in a whiteness that merges
with the sky.

2257.name: The Frigid Wastelands
2257.description:
A great boulder of blue-white ice squats in the snow, taller than a hut,
its flanks scoured smooth by the wind. Icicles hang from every lip like
fangs. Past it, the waste runs away into haze, featureless and still.
Your eyes sting with the glare.

2258.name: The Frigid Wastelands

south.description: To the south lies The Edge Of The Frigid Wastes.

2258.description:
The waste rises into a low snowy ridge, bare of anything but rime and a
few dark ribs of stone. The wind comes in hard across the crest and
fills the air with stinging crystals. A faint trail of packed snow leads
south down the slope to the edge of the wastes. A pale, cold glow
lingers in the overcast sky.

2259.name: The Frigid Wastelands
2259.description:
A hollow in the snow holds the splintered wreck of a sledge, half buried
and glazed with ice. Beside it a ring of stones surrounds the black scar
of a long-dead fire. The drifts roll away on every side, white and
silent. The cold settles into your joints like iron.

2260.name: The Edge Of The Frigid Wastes

north.description: To the north lies The Frigid Wastelands.

up.description: To the up lies On The Cliffside.

2260.description:
Here the frigid wastes end against a towering wall of dark rock streaked
with ice. A steep stair of frozen steps has been hacked into the cliff,
climbing to a keep whose broken towers hang above the cold. A path leads
north back onto the wastelands. Wind howls down the stair and tears at
your clothes.

4302.name: The Narrow Steps

up.description: To the up lies The Cliff Edge.

down.description: To the down lies The Deep Crack.

4302.description:
Steps hardly wider than a boot are cut into the cliff, worn hollow in
the middle by long use. The rock is wet and the wind tugs at your cloak.
Below, the steps drop into a crack in the meadow; above, they climb to
the cliff's brink. One slip would mean a very long fall.

4303.name: The Deep Crack

south.description: To the south lies A Green Field.

up.description: To the up lies The Narrow Steps.

4303.description:
The ground splits here into a deep crack, its sides raw red clay with
wedged stones. Water has run down the cleft for ages and left a slick of
green slime on the rocks. The meadow lies south, and a flight of narrow
steps climbs the far wall of the crack. Bleached ribs, each as long as a
spear, jut from the clay.

extra_descs.ribs bones clay:
The ribs are enormous, curved and yellowed like the frame of a wrecked
boat. Whatever owned them died here long ago.

4304.name: A Copse

east.description: To the east lies A Green Field.

south.description: To the south lies By The Great Oak.

4304.description:
A small copse of birch and rowan huddles here, its leaves rattling in
the breeze. Moss cushions the ground between the white trunks, and
enormous bare footprints have pressed deep into it. The copse opens east
onto a green field and south toward a great oak.

4305.name: A Green Field

north.description: To the north lies The Deep Crack.

east.description: To the east lies The Field.

south.description: To the south lies The Field.

west.description: To the west lies A Copse.

4305.description:
Bright grass carpets this field, startlingly green after the black
woods, and wild clover grows in thick patches. A split in the earth
gapes to the north, ragged at its lips. Meadow lies east and south, and
a small copse of pale trees grows west. A cold breeze carries the faint
smell of cookfire from somewhere far off.

4306.name: The Field

south.description: To the south lies The Field By The Waterhole.

west.description: To the west lies A Green Field.

4306.description:
Coarse grass hisses in the wind across this stretch of open field, tall
enough to hide a crouching man. A line of flattened stems runs through
it where something heavy has dragged a load. The field slopes away south
toward a muddy waterhole, and a greener meadow stretches west.

4307.name: At The Waterfall

east.description: To the east lies By The Great Oak.

south.description: To the south lies The Forest.

4307.description:
A stream tumbles over a lip of black rock in a thin white veil, and the
pool at its foot churns with spray. Ferns cling to the wet stone and the
grass is slick underfoot. A great oak stands to the east, and a forest
track slips south through the trees. The roar of the fall drowns every
other sound.

extra_descs.waterfall fall stream veil:
The water drops about three times a man's height onto black stones.
Behind the veil there is only a wet rock face.

4308.name: By The Great Oak

north.description: To the north lies A Copse.

east.description: To the east lies The Field.

south.description: To the south lies The Dense Forest.

west.description: To the west lies At The Waterfall.

up.description: To the up lies Up In The Tree House.

4308.description:
An enormous oak stands alone in a clearing, older than any wall in the
realm, its trunk wider than a hut and its roots rising like the backs of
buried beasts. A rope ladder of knotted hide hangs toward a platform
high among the boughs, and you can climb up. Fields lie east, a copse
north, the roar of falling water comes from the west, and thick forest
crowds south.

extra_descs.oak great tree ladder:
The great oak is hung with offerings: knotted cords, small skulls and
strips of red cloth. The hide ladder looks sturdy enough to bear an
ogre.

4309.name: The Field

north.description: To the north lies A Green Field.

east.description: To the east lies The Field By The Waterhole.

south.description: To the south lies The Edge Of The Forest.

west.description: To the west lies By The Great Oak.

4309.description:
Trampled grass and old fire-blackened stones mark this part of the
field, where a hunting party once stopped to eat. Splintered bones are
heaped against a lichened boulder. Open field stretches north and east,
a great oak stands to the west, and the forest begins again south.

4310.name: The Field By The Waterhole

north.description: To the north lies The Field.

east.description: To the east lies The Small Clump.

south.description: To the south lies The Edge Of The Forest.

west.description: To the west lies The Field.

4310.description:
A muddy waterhole spreads across the middle of the field, its banks
churned by huge flat footprints and fouled with scraps of gnawed
gristle. Reeds stand brown at the margin, and flies drift in clouds over
the shallows. Open ground continues north and west, a small clump of
trees waits east, and the forest edge begins south.

4311.name: The Small Clump

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Forest.

west.description: To the west lies The Field By The Waterhole.

4311.description:
A small clump of ash trees grows on a rise, their trunks bent all one
way by the wind. The grass beneath them is worn bare by something that
sleeps here, and a ring of fire-blackened stones holds nothing but cold
ash. The field falls away west toward the waterhole, and a dark forest
creeps in from the south.

4312.name: The Forest

north.description: To the north lies At The Waterfall.

east.description: To the east lies The Dense Forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Forest.

4312.description:
Tall beech and oak stand well spaced here, and the forest floor is deep
with brown leaf litter. Sunlight dapples the ground in coins of gold,
the only cheer in this part of the realm. The noise of falling water
drifts from the north. Tracks lead east into denser wood and south
through more forest.

4313.name: The Dense Forest

north.description: To the north lies By The Great Oak.

east.description: To the east lies The Edge Of The Forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Black Forest.

west.description: To the west lies The Forest.

4313.description:
The wood is so dense here that you push through rather than walk,
shouldering aside curtains of ivy and hanging vines. Dead leaves lie
ankle-deep, and the air is thick and still. A great tree looms through
the gloom to the north, the track runs east to the forest's edge, south
into the Black Forest, and west into quieter woods.

4314.name: The Edge Of The Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Field.

east.description: To the east lies The Edge Of The Forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Black Forest.

west.description: To the west lies The Dense Forest.

4314.description:
A ragged line of oaks and hawthorn marks the boundary between field and
forest. Claw marks as long as a forearm score the nearest trunk, and the
bark hangs from it in strips. Meadow lies north, the edge of the wood
runs on east, and the forest deepens south and thickens into dense woods
west.

4315.name: The Edge Of The Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Field By The Waterhole.

east.description: To the east lies The Dark Forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Murky Forest.

west.description: To the west lies The Edge Of The Forest.

4315.description:
The trees thin here, and pale light spills in from open ground ahead.
Brambles crowd the margin of the wood, snagged with tufts of coarse
black hair. The way north leads out to a field and a waterhole, a track
east dives into the Dark Forest, and another runs south into the Murky
Forest. The edge of the wood runs on west along the field's border.

4316.name: The Dark Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Small Clump.

south.description: To the south lies The Black Forest.

west.description: To the west lies The Edge Of The Forest.

4316.description:
Twisted roots grip the soil like talons in the Dark Forest, and the
canopy is so thick that noon feels like dusk. A trail of snapped twigs
and flattened ferns leads north to a small clump of trees. The black
wood continues south, and the forest edge lies west.

4317.name: The Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Forest.

east.description: To the east lies The Black Forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Narrow Crevice.

4317.description:
The trees grow gnarled and twisted here, wrapped in strangling ivy. A
narrow crevice splits the rocks to the south, while a trail leads north
through the wood and a heavy path runs east to the Black Forest. Old
bones, snapped for the marrow, litter the leaves underfoot.

4318.name: The Black Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Dense Forest.

east.description: To the east lies The Black Forest.

south.description: To the south lies Yet More Black Forest.

west.description: To the west lies The Forest.

up.description: To the up lies In The Tree.

4318.description:
A lightning-split tree dominates this part of the Black Forest, its
ruined trunk hollow and charred. A stout limb offers a way up into the
crown. Trails run north into dense woods, east toward more black timber,
south into a thicket, and west beneath the boughs of a gnarled old
forest.

4319.name: The Black Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Edge Of The Forest.

east.description: To the east lies The Murky Forest.

south.description: To the south lies By The Pool.

west.description: To the west lies The Black Forest.

4319.description:
The black trunks stand shoulder to shoulder, slick with moss on every
side but the one that gets the rain. Little grows underfoot save pale
ferns and fallen needles. The wood runs north to its edge, east into the
Murky Forest, west among yet more black trees, and south down a slope
toward a pool. A bundle of knotted grass hangs from a branch, a crude
ogre charm against bad luck.

4320.name: The Murky Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Edge Of The Forest.

east.description: To the east lies The Black Forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Black Forest.

west.description: To the west lies The Black Forest.

up.description: To the up lies Up In The Tree.

4320.description:
Mist pools between the trunks of the Murky Forest, and everything beyond
a few paces is a smudge of grey. Tracks lead north toward the edge of
the wood, east and west into the black timber, and south the way you
came. A stout old oak leans over the junction, its lowest limbs thick
enough to climb into, and tattered rags are tied along them. The ground
squelches with every step.

4321.name: The Black Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Forest.

west.description: To the west lies The Murky Forest.

4321.description:
The trees lean in over the trail here, and thorns have grown across what
once was a way on. Scraps of dried meat hang from a line stretched
between two trunks, curing in the damp air. The path winds north to the
Dark Forest and west to the Murky Forest.

4322.name: The Narrow Crevice

north.description: To the north lies The Forest.

4322.description:
The forest floor breaks into a narrow crevice between two walls of mossy
rock, so tight you must turn sideways to pass. Cold air breathes out of
the cracks, and the light fades to a green twilight. There is no way on;
the only road out is back north to the forest. Deep scratches in the
stone show where something stout once dug.

4323.name: Yet More Black Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Black Forest.

east.description: To the east lies By The Pool.

4323.description:
This is yet more black forest, and no kinder than the last. Thorns and
low branches snatch at your sleeves, and the light is a dim green murk.
Only two ways lead on from the tangle: north through the trunks and east
toward the glimmer of a pool. A huge ragged nest of sticks and hide
scraps wedges into the crook of the lowest bough.

4324.name: By The Pool

north.description: To the north lies The Black Forest.

east.description: To the east lies The Black Forest.

west.description: To the west lies Yet More Black Forest.

4324.description:
A round black pool lies in a hollow of the forest floor, its rim ringed
with stunted willows and flat stones. The water is cold and still, and
pale shapes of old bone show beneath the surface. The Black Forest
closes around the hollow: it rises north and east, and a dim way leads
west under more trees.

4325.name: The Black Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Murky Forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Woods.

west.description: To the west lies By The Pool.

4325.description:
Here the Black Forest earns its name: the trunks are wet and sooty, and
the canopy shuts out nearly all of the sky. Pale shelves of fungus crowd
the rotting logs. Paths lead north into the Murky Forest and south back
to the Dark Woods, while a trodden gap in the ferns opens west toward a
pool. Splintered bones lie scattered in the moss, cracked open for their
marrow.

4326.name: Up In The Tree House

down.description: To the down lies By The Great Oak.

4326.description:
A platform of rough planks is lashed across the boughs of the great oak,
its rails made of split saplings tied with hide. A heap of moth-eaten
skins is nailed in one corner, and the wind sways the whole structure.
The only way out is down, back to the ground beneath the oak. Far below,
the field is a green patch among the trees.

4327.name: In The Tree

down.description: To the down lies The Black Forest.

4327.description:
You cling to a broad limb of a lightning-scarred tree, the bark flaking
under your hands. Through gaps in the leaves the forest floor is a dim
tangle below, and smoke climbs from some distant fire. The way down is
the way you came, back to the black forest floor.

4328.name: Up In The Tree

down.description: To the down lies The Murky Forest.

4328.description:
The oak's crown sways gently around you, and the limb beneath your feet
is as thick as a barrel. Rags and feathers dangle from the twigs in
knotted charms. Over the tops of the trees a thin pillar of smoke rises
far off toward the horizon. The only way off the branch is down, to the
misty forest floor.

644500.name: wolf black forest
644500.long_desc: A black forest wolf prowls the shadows, its lip curled over yellow fangs.
644500.description:
This wolf is lean and shaggy, its pelt matted with burrs and old blood.
It lives off what the ogres leave behind and has lost all fear of men.

644501.name: crab rock giant
644501.long_desc: A giant rock crab scuttles among the wet boulders, claws raised in threat.
644501.description:
The crab is as broad as a shield, its shell crusted with barnacles and
weed. One heavy claw is far larger than the other, and it clacks open
and shut like a trap.

644502.name: ogre hulking village
644502.long_desc: A hulking ogre lumbers about, scratching its belly and glaring at strangers.
644502.description:
The ogre stands head and shoulders above a man, its yellowed hide hung
with patchwork furs and its belly swollen with its last feast. Small,
mean eyes fix on you from under a heavy brow, and a knotted club sits
easy in one huge fist.

644503.name: ogre warlord scarred
644503.long_desc: A scarred ogre warlord stands guard, thick arms folded across a plated chest.
644503.description:
Old battle scars crisscross this ogre's hide, and one ear has been torn
to a ragged stump. He is armoured with plates of beaten iron lashed to
his chest and wears a helm made from a horned skull. A huge maul rests
across his shoulder.

644504.name: troll frost white
644504.long_desc: A gaunt frost troll stalks the drifts, rimed with ice from crown to toe.
644504.description:
The troll is tall and stooped, its skin pale blue and cracked like
frozen mud. Long icicles hang from its chin and knuckles, and its breath
smokes in the cold.

644505.name: grushka shaman ogre bone caller
644505.long_desc: Grushka the Bone-Caller, the ogre shaman, mutters over a rattling string of knucklebones.
644505.description:
Grushka is a stooped, hook-nosed ogre hung from head to foot with bones,
feathers and dried paws. His eyes are milky white and his lips never
stop moving as he mutters curses over a staff of lashed ribs.

644506.name: brogg skullsplitter ogre chieftain
644506.long_desc: Brogg Skullsplitter, the Ogre Chieftain, looms over his chamber with a monstrous maul in hand.
644506.description:
Brogg is the largest ogre you have ever seen, his shoulders as wide as a
doorway and his arms thick as tree trunks. A necklace of fingerbones
swings across his chest, and the head of his maul is crusted with old
gore.

744500.name: pelt wolf black
744500.room_desc: A black wolf pelt lies here.
744500.description: A thick, coarse pelt of black wolf fur, rank but sound. Furriers would pay a fair price for it.

744501.name: jerkin hide ogre
744501.room_desc: A stiff ogre-hide jerkin lies here.
744501.description: A jerkin of thick, hardened hide stitched with gut. It stinks of smoke and grease but turns a blow well.

744502.name: helm helmet iron horned skull
744502.room_desc: A horned iron helm lies here.
744502.description: A helm of beaten iron, crudely riveted, with horns of bone curving from the brow. It is battered and too big for most men, but it is strong.

744503.name: charm necklace bone caller
744503.description: A string of tiny knucklebones, feathers and polished teeth, knotted with sinew. A faint, uneasy hum seems to come from it.

744504.name: maul skullsplitter ogre club
744504.room_desc: A monstrous ogre maul lies here.
744504.description: A massive maul of iron-bound oak, crowned with the stone-hard skull of a bull. Its head is stained a deep brown, and it is heavy enough to break bone with a single swing.
